decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 12 midday to midnight on monday till saturday and 12 midday until 11pm on sunday.

Condition : 5 - Before the flue extraction system is used on the premises, it shall be enclosed with sound-insulating material and mounted in a way which will minimise transmission of structure borne sound] in accordance with a scheme to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Any takeaway or delivery service shall remain ancillary to the main use of the premises as a restaurant. The premises shall not operate as a takeaway alone and no separate takeaway area shall be provided.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted for a Tandoori restaurant shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 8 - That subject to the satisfactory completion of the above legal agreement, the Borough Planning Officer be authorised to issue planning permission for the development, subject to the following safeguarding conditions.
With appropriate safeguarding conditions it is considered that this application for the change of use from A1 retail to A3 restaurant with ancillary A5 takeaway would maintain and preserve the character of the streetscene and would enhance the vitality of the parade and  Hounslow town centre. It would not have an unacceptable impact upon the surrounding environment or upon neighbours' living conditions. It complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and S.1.4 (Non-retail uses in locations outside primary and secondary frontages within the main shopping areas.)
description: Change of use from A1 Retail to A3 Restaurant with ancillary takeaway use.
